A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same gradient-analysis study. Their text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices support reliable comparison; v2's shorter appendix contains identifiable omissions rather than extraction gaps.

before.justification: V1 reports original measurements of gradient norms, effective ranks, and similarities across datasets, quality criteria, and model configurations in Sections 4–5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: V2 retains original gradient measurements in Section 4, Tables 1–3, Figures 1–3, and Appendix C, despite removing some experiments and appendix results.

M1.justification: The SFT loss, analysis of Q/K/V/O gradients, SVD-based metrics, and cosine-similarity approach remain unchanged. Removing detailed similarity definitions reduces documentation without establishing a change in the procedure.

E1.justification: Both retain WizardLM, Magpie, OpenHermes 2.5, s1.1, and GSM8K, covering the same instruction-following and mathematical-reasoning tasks. The removed fast/slow probe varies supervision within GSM8K rather than introducing a different dataset or task.

E2.justification: IFD, InsTag, Difficulty, and Reward remain the four evaluated data-quality criteria in corresponding comparisons. No competing selection algorithm is added; the removed model configurations and fast/slow conditions are experimental subjects or controls.

E3.justification: V2 omits the controlled GSM8K comparison using Qwen2.5-7B with answer-digits-only versus detailed-reasoning supervision, previously specified in Section 5.1. Retained comparisons preserve the listed model configurations and 200-high/200-low sampling counts; no rerun or changed training budget is established.

E4.justification: V1's Section 5.1 and Table 3 test how including reasoning traces affects gradient magnitude and dimensionality; this supplementary probe disappears. The principal analyses of dataset quality, model size, model family, and similarity metrics remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for these experiments. Retained results use the same descriptive reporting. The deleted release footnote concerns per-matrix statistics rather than uncertainty estimation.

E6.justification: All 27 retained table bodies are numerically identical, and retained plot images are unchanged. However, v2 removes the fast/slow results and Appendix C.4–C.7's detailed results for Llama 3.1-8B, Llama 3.2-1B/3B, and Gemma 2-2B. This substantially reduces reported evidence, although Figure 3 preserves selected cross-family reasoning curves.

T1.justification: V2 removes the explicit mathematical specification of same-layer and adjacent-layer gradient similarities from v1 Equations (3)–(4), including the projection-pair restrictions. The central SFT, SVD, nuclear-norm, and effective-rank mathematics remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same central claims about unified quality signatures, effective rank's discrimination, instruction versus reasoning data, and similarities within versus differences between model families.

C2.justification: V2 adds an explicit Limitation acknowledging that downstream data selection using the spectral statistics has not been experimentally validated. It also removes Section 5.1's interpretation that explicit reasoning aligns more naturally with existing parameters. Other principal interpretations remain.

D1.justification: V1's introduction footnote describes a planned release of sample pairs, losses, complete singular values, and other gradient statistics. V2 removes that disclosure. The project link, named scoring models, and Appendix B evaluation prompts remain.

R1.justification: V2 adds Wu et al. (2025) on usable XAI and four reasoning references by Li and Xiong in Appendix A.3. Existing research positioning remains substantially unchanged; the reasoning survey relabeled from Li et al. (2025c) to (2025e) is retained.

P1.justification: Most retained prose is unchanged. V2 removes Further Discussion as a separate section, moves its similarity discussion to Section 4.2.4, adds Limitation, shortens Appendix C, and makes limited wording and affiliation edits.

P2.justification: V2 switches the main text to two columns and extensively redistributes tables, figures, and appendix material. Entire displays disappear with the omitted experiments and model sections. Appendix headings become isolated on otherwise empty pages 17, 22, and 27, while retained plots preserve their original content.

improvement.justification: The new limitation usefully acknowledges the absence of downstream selection validation. However, removing the fast/slow control, detailed Llama/Gemma evidence, and similarity specifications reduces support and reproducibility while broad claims remain unchanged. The central results and main cross-family figure survive, making this a limited net decline rather than a fundamental loss of the study.
